newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Mediterranean meeting told EU funds ready.
newsitem.headline: Mediterranean meeting told EU funds ready.

text.p: A representative of the European Commission told 20 countries at a meeting on Mediterranean development on Wednesday that credits were available to tackle the region's problems but priorities needed to be defined.
"We have credits and we want to use them but it's important to have clear ideas and strategies first," Fernand Thurmes told the meeting of experts discussing sustainable development in the region.

Moroccan Environment Minister Nouredine Ben Omar Alami said the countries planned to give priority to rational management of water and look at ways to deal with problems affecting the fishing and tourist industries.
